DLC2308:4:t_100:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「You're unusually aggressive in your command today...」

DLC2308:4:t_100:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Of course I am! If we waste time on enemies like these, we'll never take $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

DLC2308:4:t_100:3.en:
$$オットー$$
（If we return quickly, I can treat everyone to my prized tea at the end of the party too...!）

DLC2308:4:t_101:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Um... I'm sorry, $n... You went to the trouble of cooking, and I didn't eat any...」

DLC2308:4:t_101:1.en:
$n
「It's all right... $$セツコ$$, $$エマ$$, $$ノイン$$ and the others turned it down too...」

DLC2308:4:t_101:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... um... Maybe I'll try a little when we get back... It's not often I get to eat something like that...」

DLC2308:4:t_101:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... But... maybe there's none left...」

DLC2308:4:t_101:5.en:
$n
「Don't worry! Nobody's eating it because they think it looks disgusting!」

DLC2308:4:t_101:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't get depressed over your own words!」

DLC2308:4:t_102:0.en:
$$宗介$$
（My tastes have gotten refined... $$クルツ$$ is right about that...）

DLC2308:4:t_102:1.en:
$$宗介$$
（If we succeed in taking $$ラース・バビロン$$, the war will end, and I can go back to Japan...）

DLC2308:4:t_102:2.en:
$$宗介$$
（Then I'll try telling $$千鳥$$ that I want to have her miso soup.）

DLC2308:4:t_103:1.en:
$$刹那$$
（It's been a while. I'd like to eat that again...）

DLC2308:4:t_104:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$... I'll never forget the coffee you made me...）

DLC2308:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It's a shame we had to leave the party halfway through.」

DLC2308:4:t_105:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's fine. This will make for some good exercise after a meal.」

DLC2308:4:t_105:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Besides, coffee tastes especially good after finishing a job.」

DLC2308:4:t_105:3.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Then I'll prepare the finest cup, so let's get home quickly.」

DLC2308:4:t_105:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Understood, $$ドロシー#bigo$$. I'll look forward to it.」

DLC2308:4:t_106:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You're in top form, $$シモン$$.」

DLC2308:4:t_106:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's been ages since I ate $$ニア$$'s specialty.」

DLC2308:4:t_106:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I'll take $$ラース・バビロン$$ and get $$ニア$$ and the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ back in no time!」

DLC2308:4:t_107:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（Forcing myself to eat with my mask on has left the inside all sticky...）

DLC2308:4:t_107:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（But this too is retribution for what I've done...! This discomfort is a punishment I impose upon myself!）

DLC2308:4:t_108:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Damage detected in Ensign $$レド$$'s body... in the series of organs responsible for food intake and digestion.」

DLC2308:4:t_108:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This resembles the reaction to introducing a foreign substance into the body.」

DLC2308:4:t_108:3.en:
$$レド$$
「It's all right, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. I'm sure that's normal food in the region where $$シモン$$ and the others live.」

DLC2308:4:t_108:4.en:
$$レド$$
「In fact, $$シモン$$ seemed to find it delicious.」

DLC2308:4:t_108:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That matter is incomprehensible.」

DLC2308:4:t_108:6.en:
$$レド$$
「But I will return alive! $$エイミー$$ is waiting with seaweed bread for me when I get back from this sortie!」

DLC2308:4:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Are you feeling all right, $$ノノ$$?」

DLC2308:4:t_109:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Y-yes...! For an instant after I ate $$シモン$$'s food, my thought circuits went somewhere I didn't recognize, but...」

DLC2308:4:t_109:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Maybe one more bite would have cured your memory loss.」

DLC2308:4:t_109:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「P-please spare me! I never want to eat that again!」

DLC2308:4:t_109:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm kidding. When we get back, let's have something to get rid of that taste.」

DLC2308:4:t_109:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! Let's toast with cocoa, just the two of us, Big Sis!」

review.context: Battle banter returns to the feast: Otto wants to serve tea, Suzune offers to try Hibiki's food, Sousuke longs for Kaname's miso soup, Simon is powered by Nia's cooking, and Ledo and Nono recover from eating it.
decisions: Sousuke's desire for Kaname's miso soup retains the domestic implication without adding a marriage proposal.
Setsuna's unspecified desired food remains 'that' because the later apple scene supplies its meaning.
Zero's sticky-mask self-punishment is kept literal as a comic confession.
Nono calls Lal'C Big Sis as an affectionate senior address, not a literal-sister claim.
Short inward 'A meal...' recollections are deliberate trailing thoughts preserved from the source.
